description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling 'ModifyAcl' commands in a persistent actor system for managing access control lists of 'Thing' entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It validates the ACL, creates an event indicating modification, and returns the result.

classes.name: ModifyAclStrategy
classes.description: This class is a final, immutable strategy that handles the modification of Access Control Lists (ACLs) for 'Thing' entities, validating input, creating modification events, and providing optional entity tags.

methods.name: ModifyAclStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the 'ModifyAcl' command type.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the ACL modification logic: validates the new ACL, creates an AclModified event, and returns a result encapsulating the event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag for the previous 'Thing' entity, if available, based on its current ACL.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the EntityTag for the new 'Thing' entity after ACL modification.
